states_from_plan.EFFECTIVE: c > b AND p < 0.05 -> may state: B accepted more than A on this batch (n=102 pairs, 34 tasks x 3 reps), direction-consistent with the offline real-signal row (polyglot_py +9.7pp, n=68) and the v3 direction (3/3 reps). May NOT state 'proves better' (one batch, one model, H-12).
states_from_plan.CONTRADICTS: c < b AND p < 0.05 -> no effect claim in EITHER direction; investigate. 'the loop is harmful' is NOT a pre-registered conclusion (R532 AMEND1 direction guard: a significant result in the opposite direction has no pre-registered state and draws no harm conclusion).
states_from_plan.UNRESOLVED: otherwise (including c > b with p >= 0.05) -> record direction and magnitude only; a null here is not a negative result.
states_from_plan.INCOMPLETE: fewer than the 3 registered reps present at analysis time -> resume the incomplete (task, arm, rep) cells (the runner skips completed cells; resume is infrastructure, not a design change) and analyze only once all 3 registered reps exist. If the batch cannot be completed (model slot down, disk, etc.), report completed reps descriptively only; no decision state assigned; partial batch is neither clean nor dirty.

caveats: single model, single slot, 34 tasks: does not transfer to another model/harness/budget/corpus without re-running (H-12)

the model channel is a single slot shared with the loop harness; wall times are not a metric and long model calls serialize (v3 observed 4-14s/run on the 6 small tasks; the 28 additional tasks include larger ones, so the v4 batch may span two rounds — the INCOMPLETE/resume rule above governs)
max_tokens=4096 per attempt: a truncated answer is a legitimate failure of the attempt, not infra_void; both arms face the same ceiling
v1 (3/6 vs 2/6), v2 (4/6 vs 4/6) remain unregistered smoke evidence and v3 (n=18, UNRESOLVED) is its own registered batch; this prereg does not pool them and does not retroactively cover them
